free_tier.stated: 'Starter is a free offering with a single registry and repository to let you try out DOCR.' Storage 500 MiB: table row 'Storage | 500 MiB | 5 GiB | 100 GiB'. Allowance is prorated by active days: 'If a Starter registry is active for 16 days in a month, it receives ~285 MiB of storage allowance'.

egress.terms: No egress charge is stated for DOCR anywhere on the pricing or limits page; DOCR is described as 'a private Docker image registry', so there is no public/anonymous pull path and no CDN-facing egress at all.

tooling: Doctl registry, docker. Private only. Pulls require a DO API token.
chaining: 1 registry, 1 repository, 500 MiB. Not worth chaining; a second account buys 500 MiB more.
limits_note: 1 registry, 1 repository, 500 MiB prorated; 100 GB max image, 20 GB max per layer; untagged images count toward quota; storage overage 'Not Available' on Starter (hard stop).
reliability_note: Starter's prorated storage means a fresh registry can be charged overage on a partial month; 500 MiB is below any useful dataset.

evidence.proved: (Last verified 13 Jul 2026) — Starter $0.00, 500 MiB, 1 repo; 'Extra Storage | Not Available'

evidence.proved: Starter storage is prorated by active days
evidence.quote: For example, a Starter registry receives 500 MiB of allowance per full month. If a Starter registry is active for 16 days in a month, it receives ~285 MiB of storage allowance ((16 days/28 days) * 500 MiB).

evidence.proved: image cap is 100 GB and 20 GB per layer
evidence.quote: You cannot upload images over 100 GB to a container registry. You are limited to a maximum size of 20 GB per image layer.
